Kishore, an orphaned boy, aspires to serve in the Indian Army. However, when he is kicked out, a former army officer hesitantly takes him in.
Vibha's joyful married life is shattered when her husband, Captain Vikrant Sahay, is killed in combat. Determined to honor his legacy, she resolves to enlist in the armed forces.

Tribhuvan, a dedicated Indian Army Officer comes across a young sweeper Tinku, who is a gifted shooter. Tribhuvan knows Tinku has a rare talent, and wants to enroll him in the shooting academy and then the Indian Army. However, owing to Tinku's caste, his father is afraid of society's taunts and is completely against this career choice.
Balram battles psychological scars from combat while attempting to bridge the distance with his son, Aman. However, his lingering wartime trauma complicates their fragile emotional reunion.
Veera's martyred father's last wish was for her to join the armed forces, but she resentfully believes that the bravery and patriotism her father is remembered for are the reasons that took him away.
Viraj and Arjun are childhood friends, but while Viraj enjoys his single status and is keen for Arjun to be his roommate, Arjun harbours other ideas.
The gang comes together to celebrate Arjun's wedding news. However, Viraj is concerned about the group dynamics changing with a new member coming in.
Khushi's unconventional celebration party takes centre stage on Arjun's birthday. Later, Viraj confronts Arjun about his behaviour.
The group attempts to ease the strained relationship between Viraj and Arjun. Later, a frustrated Viraj begins to learn more about his true self when he confides in Zara and Kaka.
On his wedding day, Arjun wonders if Viraj will support him during the ceremony. Tensions rise as Viraj grapples with a hidden desire to confess his feelings to a special guest.
Shagun agrees to film a wedding for Adhira's former partner to keep their struggling business afloat. However, a resentful Adhira attempts to sabotage the entire production.
Adhira and Shagun disagree about whom to select for a wedding film promotion. Soon, things take a turn for the complicated when the parents also weigh in with their respective biases.
The sisters want Vishnu to take up the role of an office boy and help sort out their business affairs. However, the parents are naturally opposed to the idea, leading to another standoff.
The sisters discover a recording of a drunken confession from the bride's best friend amongst their wedding footage. However, the pair clash while debating the morality of the truth.
The sisters find themselves at opposite sides of a dilemma while chasing a business pitch as Adhira is reluctant to make a long-term commitment but Shagun wants to seize the opportunity.

Shaurya struggles to gain recognition for his hard work, while Sanya debates leaving her home. The two then help each other step out of their comfort zones to achieve personal growth.
As Shaurya and Sanya move in together, Sanya takes a major gamble at work that profoundly impacts both of their lives. Concurrently, the couple confronts the dilemma of prioritising their emotions.
As Shaurya and Sanya face the realisation that they have fallen for each other, they must confront a crucial dilemma, prioritising their emotions over logic.

Having finally admitted their feelings, Shaurya and Sanya's honeymoon weekend ends, forcing them back to reality with Shaurya up for a promotion while Sanya is feeling doubtful about her career growth.
With appraisals approaching, Shaurya and Sanya prepare themselves for the unexpected. Later, Shaurya eventually gets his first real lesson in team management.

To mark 3 months of being together, Shaurya convinces Sanya to organise something for their monthiversary. However, things begin to get complicated as Shaurya finds himself working directly with Sanya - for the first time since they started dating.
Shaurya eventually ends up at Akhil's party but to his surprise does not feel like he belongs there. Meanwhile, Ratna invites Sanya to have a drink with her.
Shaurya's presentation does not go as planned, and he ends up overpromising samples to the client on a three-day deadline. This leads to the team having to work round the clock.
Sanya opts to return to her room, the news Shaurya greets with displeasure. Compounding his stress, Akhil reprimands him for overcommitting and nearly losing the client.

Neerav Kapoor encounters his namesake, sparking immense confusion. It remains unclear if one will frisk the other or simply steal the spotlight.
Now working as a casting director, Nero devises an extensive plan to take action against his former associate, Neerav 2.
Nero establishes M.A.U.S.I., a revolutionary agony aunt for actors. Meanwhile, Minnie uses Robin as a guinea pig for her unconventional methods.
Nero celebrates a major breakthrough when he lands a role in a television show without having to audition. However, questions arise regarding the nature of the role.
Nero steps out of his comfort zone to explore writing and being Robin's gym instructor. Later, he tries a strange cylindrical scheme to see if he can achieve excellence.
Nero navigates the complex world of entertainment as he tries his hand at writing. Meanwhile, Minnie puts words in Robin's mouth.
Robin's movie career takes an unexpected turn when some odd developments occur. In the meantime, Nero decides to join theatre.
Unable to decide who will get the privilege of living in Nero's house with him, Robin and Jubilant get into a petty fight.
Nero introduces Mausi and Mukesh to each other. Meanwhile, Minnie and Robin try to work through the rough patch in their relationship.
Nero helms a factual Mausi production starring Noro, but quits for a major acting gig. Meanwhile, he fights Neerav 2 as Minnie joins the search.
Arun's tedious office role contrasts sharply with the success of his old esports squad. However, this encounter revives his competitive fire and sparks doubt regarding his previous life decisions.

Arun realizes he can't win alone and begins the hunt for a new team. He recruits a misfit squad with Prachi, a badminton player struggling with an injury, Jeetu, a delivery boy with natural, lightning-fast reflexes, Adil, a young, tech-savvy enthusiast who acts as the team's initial bridge, and Raunak, a volatile but highly skilled fragger. The task is harder than Arun anticipated, as he has to convince these individuals that they have what it takes to be pros.
The team comes together, but tension stays. However, each player faces old issues, so they must work as one or risk failure in the end.
Team Clutch must set aside their personal grievances as the tournament begins. The players must find a way to unite or crumble under the intense match pressure.

Team Clutch enters the final stage with a singular goal of securing the ultimate championship title. The squad must give their absolute best to claim victory.
While studying for his government exams, Raviranjan prioritises his social life over his work. His romance with Jyoti threatens to derail his career goals before they even begin.
Ravi fails his first OSC test and his family taunt him. Thus, Jyoti forms a fresh plan to help him achieve success for his next attempt.

Ravi and Jyoti both have surprise villains that wreak havoc in their lives. Tempers fly in both homes, and Ravi's future with Jyoti and OSC stands at a crossroads with no turning back. Will he find his way back?

Ravi ne liya hai ek naya roop, with no question paper being a match for him. But OSC still finds ways to test his patience. Does Ravi finally land his Sarkari Naukri? Or will he forever remain an aspirant like so many young Indians?

The episode sets the stage for the ultimate Generation Gap social experiment. Akash (Rohan Shah) and Pooja (Aditi Myakal) are a modern married couple living in a spacious Mumbai apartment. However, their lifestyle is outpacing their income, leading them to a radical decision: renting out their spare rooms to bachelors.
Balan and Aashna clash with the bachelors to secure control of the television. Later, the boys create unusual problems to prevent the pair from watching their desired film.
Balan and Aashna must join forces with the dishevelled bachelors to fight a common enemy, the unfriendly neighbourhood mouse.
Tensions escalate when Veer and Akash get into a heated dispute, causing friction within their friend group. Meanwhile, Aashna and Balan find themselves locked in an intense confrontation.
Gen Z designer Maya joins a mental health startup only to face toxic hustle and tight deadlines. As burnout peaks before a major launch, will she or her team dare to speak up?
Ignored ideas and non-stop pressure push a sleep-deprived Maya to her limit. Surrounded by burnt-out colleagues, she searches for empathy as workspace stress spirals out of control.
Maya’s impulsive choices and mental health advocacy put her at odds with the higher-ups. After a tense meeting, she must decide if her mission is worth risking her standing in the system.
Staff obsess over trivial glitches while ignoring deep-seated toxicity. However, a colleague's exhaustion-led collapse sparks a viral public outcry.
